prompt: In step 1 you rebuilt the first frame of an animated GIF as a three.js scene. Your step 1 page is below. The attached images are eight keyframes of the same GIF, in order, at these times from the loop start: image 1 at 0 ms, image 2 at 600 ms, image 3 at 1270 ms, image 4 at 1870 ms, image 5 at 2470 ms, image 6 at 3070 ms, image 7 at 3730 ms, image 8 at 4330 ms. The GIF loops every 4390 ms. Task (3D, animation): animate your step 1 scene so that render(t) matches the GIF's motion at those times. Start from your step 1 page; you may fix or improve it. The animation loops with a period of exactly 4390 ms, so render(t) and render(t + 4390) are identical, and render(0) must match the first keyframe. three.js contract: - The harness injects an import map for three.js r187. Import from 'three' and from 'three/addons/'; the only addons available are 'three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ConvexGeometry.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ParametricFunctions.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ParametricGeometry.js', 'three/addons/geometries/RoundedBoxGeometry.js', 'three/addons/math/ConvexHull.js', 'three/addons/utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js'. Use one
html:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html><head><meta charset="utf-8"><style>html,body{margin:0;padding:0;overflow:hidden;background:#38391c}canvas{display:block;position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:240px;height:240px}</style></head><body>
<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';
const P=4390;
const renderer=new THREE.WebGLRenderer({preserveDrawingBuffer:true,antialias:true});
renderer.setPixelRatio(1);renderer.setSize(240,240,false);document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);
const scene=new THREE.Scene();scene.background=new THREE.Color(0x38391c);
const camera=new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(16.26,1,0.5,80);camera.position.set(0,0,14);camera.lookAt(0,0,0);
scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xfff6d8,0x6a5522,1.7));
const key=new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xfff2d0,2.0);key.position.set(-2,5,6);scene.add(key);
const back=new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff,1.2);back.position.set(3,3,-6);scene.add(back);

const Y=new THREE.Vector3(0,1,0),Z=new THREE.Vector3(0,0,1),v=new THREE.Vector3(),v2=new THREE.Vector3();
const sm=(a,b,x)=>{x=Math.min(1,Math.max(0,(x-a)/(b-a)));return x*x*(3-2*x);};
const pw=(a,e)=>Math.sign(a)*Math.pow(Math.abs(a),e);
const mat=c=>new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:c,roughness:0.7});
const vmat=()=>new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({vertexColors:true,roughness:0.7});
function fixN(g,ws,hs){g.computeVertexNormals();const n=g.attributes.normal;
  for(let iy=0;iy<=hs;iy++){const a=iy*(ws+1),b=a+ws;
    if(iy===0||iy===hs){for(let ix=0;ix<=ws;ix++)n.setXYZ(a+ix,0,iy===0?1:-1,0);continue;}
    v.set(n.getX(a)+n.getX(b),n.getY(a)+n.getY(b),n.getZ(a)+n.getZ(b)).normalize();
    n.setXYZ(a,v.x,v.y,v.z);n.setXYZ(b,v.x,v.y,v.z);}
  n.needsUpdate=true;}
function limb(m,A,B,tot){const l=A.distanceTo(B);m.position.copy(A).add(B).multiplyScalar(0.5);
  m.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(Y,v2.subVectors(B,A).normalize());m.scale.set(1,l/tot,1);}

const character=new THREE.Group();character.name='character-blob';scene.add(character);
const skinM=mat(0xdcb24c);

// ---------- torso ----------
const TW=240,TH=150;
const tg=new THREE.SphereGeometry(1,TW,TH);tg.rotateY(-Math.PI/2);
{const tp=tg.attributes.position,col=new Float32Array(tp.count*3);
 const cS=new THREE.Color(0xdcb24c),cF=new THREE.Color(0xd8d4c6),cT=new THREE.Color(0x70705f),c=new THREE.Color();
 for(let i=0;i<tp.count;i++){
  const x=2.3*pw(tp.getX(i),0.6),y=-1.85+2.0*pw(tp.getY(i),0.6),z=1.3*pw(tp.getZ(i),0.8);
  tp.setXYZ(i,x,y,z);
  const ax=Math.abs(x),nb=-0.9-0.85*sm(-0.3,0.3,z);
  const dn=(y-(nb+0.6*Math.pow(ax,3.2)))/Math.sqrt(1+Math.pow(1.92*Math.pow(ax,2.2),2));
  const da=Math.min(ax-(1.55+0.15*(y+1)*(y+1)+0.25*z*z),y+2.2);
  const s=Math.max(dn,da);
  c.copy(cF).lerp(cS,sm(-0.015,0.015,s)).lerp(cT,1-sm(0.03,0.075,Math.abs(s)));
  col[i*3]=c.r;col[i*3+1]=c.g;col[i*3+2]=c.b;}
 tg.setAttribute('color',new THREE.BufferAttribute(col,3));}
fixN(tg,TW,TH);
const torso=new THREE.Mesh(tg,vmat());torso.name='torso';character.add(torso);

// ---------- arms ----------
const handM=mat(0x4a4f30);
function makeArm(s){
  const g=new THREE.Group();g.name=s>0?'arm-left':'arm-right';
  const up=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(0.5,1,6,14),skinM);
  const fo=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(0.3,1,6,12),skinM);
  const S=new THREE.Vector3(s*1.95,-0.9,0),E=new THREE.Vector3(s*2.35,-2.7,0.3);
  limb(up,S,E,2);
  const hand=new THREE.Group();hand.name=s>0?'hand-left':'hand-right';
  const palm=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(1,16,12),handM);palm.scale.set(0.3,0.24,0.17);hand.add(palm);
  for(let i=0;i<4;i++){const f=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(0.06,0.22,4,8),handM);
    f.position.set(-s*0.3,0.14-0.09*i,0.02);f.rotation.z=Math.PI/2+s*(0.25-0.12*i);hand.add(f);}
  hand.rotation.set(-0.2,0,s*0.25);
  g.add(up,fo,hand);character.add(g);
  return {fo,hand,E,s,H:new THREE.Vector3()};
}
const arms=[makeArm(1),makeArm(-1)];

// ---------- head ----------
const head=new THREE.Group();head.name='head';character.add(head);
function headSurf(dx,dy,dz,puff,o){
  const b=Math.exp(-Math.pow((dy+0.35)/0.45,2));
  const side=dx*dx/(dx*dx+dz*dz+1e-5);
  const pb=puff*Math.exp(-Math.pow((dy+0.45)/0.42,2))*(0.3+0.7*side)*sm(-0.6,0.2,dz);
  return o.set(dx*(0.95+0.42*b+0.14*pb),dy*1.15-0.2*pb,dz*(1+0.15*b+0.14*pb));
}
const HW=56,HH=40;
const hg=new THREE.SphereGeometry(1,HW,HH);hg.rotateY(-Math.PI/2);
const hb=hg.attributes.position.array.slice();
{const hc=new Float32Array(hb.length),cTop=new THREE.Color(0xeedc7a),cBot=new THREE.Color(0xd9a844),cBl=new THREE.Color(0xf08a66),c=new THREE.Color();
 for(let i=0;i<hb.length;i+=3){const x=hb[i],y=hb[i+1],z=hb[i+2];
  c.copy(cBot).lerp(cTop,sm(-0.7,0.6,y));
  const d=Math.abs(x)*0.72-y*0.33+z*0.61;
  c.lerp(cBl,0.8*Math.exp(-(1-d)/0.07));
  hc[i]=c.r;hc[i+1]=c.g;hc[i+2]=c.b;}
 hg.setAttribute('color',new THREE.BufferAttribute(hc,3));}
const headMesh=new THREE.Mesh(hg,vmat());headMesh.name='head-skin';headMesh.position.y=0.65;head.add(headMesh);
function poseHead(puff){const p=hg.attributes.position;
  for(let i=0,j=0;i<p.count;i++,j+=3){headSurf(hb[j],hb[j+1],hb[j+2],puff,v);p.setXYZ(i,v.x,v.y,v.z);}
  p.needsUpdate=true;fixN(hg,HW,HH);hg.computeBoundingSphere();}

// eyes
const eyes=new THREE.Group();eyes.name='eyes';eyes.position.y=0.65;head.add(eyes);
const lidM=mat(0xecd876),darkM=mat(0x1e2412);
function makeEye(s){
  const g=new THREE.Group();g.name=s>0?'eye-left':'eye-right';
  headSurf(s*0.657,0.37,0.657,0,v);g.position.copy(v).multiplyScalar(0.94);
  g.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(Z,new THREE.Vector3(s*0.4,0.05,1).normalize());
  const rim=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.235,20,14),darkM);rim.position.z=-0.055;
  const ball=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.2,20,14),mat(0x9ac85c));
  const pupil=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.125,16,12),mat(0x0a0c08));pupil.position.z=0.15;pupil.scale.z=0.5;pupil.name='pupil';
  const upper=new THREE.Group();upper.name='eyelid-upper';
  upper.add(new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.25,20,10,0,Math.PI*2,0,Math.PI/2),lidM));
  const line=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TorusGeometry(0.25,0.016,6,28),darkM);line.rotation.x=Math.PI/2;upper.add(line);
  const lower=new THREE.Group();lower.name='eyelid-lower';
  lower.add(new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.25,20,10,0,Math.PI*2,Math.PI/2,Math.PI/2),lidM));
  g.add(rim,ball,pupil,upper,lower);eyes.add(g);
  return {s,upper,lower};
}
const eyeL=[makeEye(1),makeEye(-1)];

// mouth
const mouth=new THREE.Group();mouth.name='mouth';head.add(mouth);
const lipG=new THREE.TorusGeometry(0.55,0.022,6,20,1.1);lipG.rotateZ(Math.PI/2-0.55);
const lip=new THREE.Mesh(lipG,mat(0x5a3a18));lip.name='lip-line';
lip.rotation.x=0.66;lip.position.set(0,-0.55*Math.cos(0.66),-0.55*Math.sin(0.66)+0.012);
const lipHolder=new THREE.Group();lipHolder.add(lip);mouth.add(lipHolder);
const cavity=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(1,24,16),mat(0x4a1418));cavity.name='mouth-cavity';
const toothM=mat(0xf2efe2);
const tU=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TorusGeometry(0.84,0.15,8,24,Math.PI),toothM);tU.position.z=0.5;tU.name='teeth-upper';
const tL=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TorusGeometry(0.84,0.11,8,24,Math.PI),toothM);tL.position.z=0.5;tL.rotation.z=Math.PI;tL.name='teeth-lower';
const tongue=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.5,14,10),mat(0xc0504e));tongue.position.set(0,-0.35,0.75);tongue.scale.set(1,0.7,0.6);tongue.name='tongue';
cavity.add(tU,tL,tongue);mouth.add(cavity);

// ---------- animation ----------
const KT=[0,600,1270,1870,2470,3070,3730,4330,4390];
const K={
  puff:[0,0.05,0.5,1,1,1,0.45,0.3,0.3],
  pitch:[0,0,0.04,0.1,0.11,0.1,-0.15,-1.0,-1.02],
  squint:[0,0.08,0.45,0.78,0.8,0.8,1,1,1],
  open:[0,0,0,0,0,0,0.35,1,1],
  up:[0,0,0.04,0.12,0.12,0.12,0.1,0.7,0.72],
  sc:[1,1,1,1,1,1,1.02,1.05,1.05],
  hy:[0,0,-0.07,-0.2,-0.2,-0.2,-0.05,-0.27,-0.27],
  handY:[-3.2,-3.2,-3.0,-1.8,-1.78,-1.75,-1.63,-2.03,-2.05]
};
function kv(a,t){let i=0;while(i<KT.length-2&&t>=KT[i+1])i++;
  let u=(t-KT[i])/(KT[i+1]-KT[i]);u=Math.min(1,Math.max(0,u));u=u*u*(3-2*u);return a[i]+(a[i+1]-a[i])*u;}

function render(t){
  t=((t%P)+P)%P;
  const puff=kv(K.puff,t),pitch=kv(K.pitch,t),squint=kv(K.squint,t),open=kv(K.open,t),
        up=kv(K.up,t),sc=kv(K.sc,t),hy=kv(K.hy,t),handY=kv(K.handY,t);
  character.position.set(0,up,0);character.scale.setScalar(sc);
  head.position.set(0,-0.1+hy,0);head.rotation.set(pitch,0,0);
  poseHead(puff);
  headSurf(0,-0.16,0.987,puff,v);mouth.position.set(0,0.65+v.y,v.z);
  const isOpen=open>=0.03;
  lipHolder.visible=!isOpen;lipHolder.scale.setScalar(1+0.25*puff);
  cavity.visible=isOpen;
  cavity.scale.set(0.48+0.08*open,0.06+0.5*open,0.22);cavity.position.set(0,-0.12,-0.12);
  const a=-1.15+0.9*squint,b=1.15-1.35*sm(0.5,1,squint);
  const roll=0.35*sm(0.2,0.7,squint)*(1-sm(0,0.3,open));
  for(const e of eyeL){e.upper.rotation.set(a,0,-e.s*roll);e.lower.rotation.set(b,0,-e.s*roll*0.5);}
  const rest=Math.min(1,Math.max(0,(-1.8-handY)/1.4));
  for(const A of arms){
    A.H.set(A.s*(0.8+0.6*rest),handY,1.5-0.3*rest);
    limb(A.fo,A.E,A.H,1.6);A.hand.position.copy(A.H);
  }
  renderer.render(scene,camera);
}
render(0);
window.nwb={scene,renderer,cameras:{ref:camera},characters:[character],render,ready:true};
</script>
</body></html>
